parameters.query:
SELECT tipo, chave, dono_id, transcricao,
  CASE WHEN tipo = 'leo' THEN nucleo.memoria_resumo(dono_id) ELSE nucleo.base_resumo() END AS contexto
FROM nucleo.aprendiz_pendentes_todos(10)

SELECT CASE
  WHEN $3 = 'leo' THEN nucleo.aprendiz_leo_salvar(nullif($4, '')::int, $1, $2::jsonb)
  WHEN $3 = 'joao' THEN nucleo.aprendiz_salvar(nullif($1, '')::int, $2::jsonb)
  ELSE 0 END AS salvos

parameters.jsCode:
const n = $input.all().reduce((a, i) => a + (+i.json.salvos || 0), 0);
return [{ json: { sugestoes: n } }];
